name: WayriCAD Quick PI
description: DC PI, explicit rail transients and QuickTherm-based electrothermal coupling.
description_full: Solve DC voltage drop, current density and Joule loss on saved traces, pads, filled zones and plated via barrels. The default 2.5D model and an optional Gmsh tetrahedral 3D copper-volume model have native result views and export field evidence. Independently specified current sinks support supply budgets and voltage requirements. Explicit R/L/C load-step studies, uniform-grid steady electrothermal coupling and lumped thermal-RC transient coupling are available with declared parameters and model limits. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy, VTK and Matplotlib is required; the 3D mode additionally needs Gmsh. These are screening models; full-wave AC and regulator current-limit control loops are not modeled.
